subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.**

The invitation card very clearly mentions that the **__entry in the show will be__** closed at 6 p.m.

options.text: entry about the show will be
entry over the show will be
entry on the show will be
entry to the show will be

solution:
The correct answer is **"****entry to the show will be."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The underlined segment **“entry in the show will be__” **contains a prepositional error.
 
• The error lies in the part **“entry in.”**
 
• **It must be replaced to “entry to.”**
 
• We use** "entry in"** when we are referring to being included or listed in a particular group, competition, or category.
 __
 
• **Example**:* Her name was the first **entry in**__ the list of participants.*
 
 
 
• We use **"entry to"** when we are referring to gaining access or admission to a place, event, or location.
 __
 
• **Example**: *The ticket grants you **entry to**__ the museum.*
 
 
 
• It clarifies that the entry relates to the show itself.
 
• That’s why** ‘to’ i**s appropriate.
 
• The other options are grammatically incorrect.
 
• So, the correct answer is Option 4.

 

**Correct sentence: ***“The invitation card very clearly mentions that the “__entry to the show will be__” closed at 6 p.m.”*
